items.passage: Yesterday was a strange day for Tina. Although the sky was sunny in the morning, it started to rain after lunch. She got wet because she forgot her umbrella. When she got home, she felt cold, so she drank some hot soup. She wanted to study, but she was too tired. Before she went to bed, she packed her bag so she wouldn't forget anything the next day.

items.advPassage: Although Leo is only thirteen, he already helps his parents at their small shop. After school, he goes there because his parents are very busy. He cleans the tables and takes orders, so the customers don't have to wait long. Some days he feels tired, but he is happy when customers smile. He believes that if he works hard now, he will learn many useful skills for the future.
